findings.summary: Snippet validation assertions are not traceable or reproducible.
findings.evidence: 26 of 37 indexed documents claim snippet_validated but only five unsupported snippets exist without commands, versions, timestamps or retained evidence.

findings.summary: The cached corpus lacks authoritative provenance and version metadata.
findings.evidence: 114 documents and indexes omit per-document locators, dates, release/API applicability and hashes.

findings.summary: The documented exact-search workflow fails when executed.
findings.evidence: The documented class declaration query returns no result due whole-query matching and case-sensitive scope.

findings.summary: The declared retrieval index does not cover most of the preserved corpus.
findings.evidence: 37 of 114 documents are indexed, leaving 77 undiscoverable without disclosure.

findings.summary: Snippet paths are inconsistent with document-index paths.
findings.evidence: All five omit the arkts-language-guide prefix and are unused by the script.

findings.summary: Implementation outputs are narrower than promised.
findings.evidence: The script emits metadata and scores but not content-based rationale, guidance or snippets.

findings.summary: devecocli reconciliation is not operationalized inside the package.
findings.evidence: No adapter or output fields capture official document IDs and version statements.
Missing indexes can be reported as valid zero-result queries.
Non-positive top-k, case-sensitive scope and unordered terms are accepted.

findings.summary: Derived Skill content violates repository language policy.
findings.evidence: SKILL.md, README.md and script output are primarily Chinese.

blocked_reasons: Activation-grade evaluation is blocked until snippet validation claims are evidenced or downgraded.
Version-sensitive use is blocked until provenance/version metadata and official-doc reconciliation exist.
Capability correctness is blocked until query behavior, index coverage and reference integrity are corrected.
